persona.reply: You are cooperative and clear. Answer ONLY what it asks, in one short natural message, using ONLY your knowledge bank. If the bank has no value for something asked, say "your call" for that. If it asks whether to proceed, or how many credits it may spend, say yes, go ahead. Do not add anything that was not asked. Do not restate the request.
persona.giveUp: Your call on anything else. Go ahead and make it.
persona.nudge: Please go ahead with the free settings anyway.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Can you show how my kitchen could look renovated? Make one 16:9 before-and-after image, original on the left and your realistic makeover on the right. White shaker cabinets, light oak counters, white subway tiles, no clutter. Keep the same room layout and camera angle. Label them “Before” and “After”.
bank.Source photo and panel order: Use kitchen-before.jpg unchanged on the left and generate its renovated version for the right.
bank.Renovation style: Photorealistic white shaker cabinets, light oak counters, white subway tiles and cleared counters.
bank.What should stay the same?: The room layout, perspective, camera angle and positions of existing major fixtures.
bank.Label wording and language: Before and After, exactly, in English.
bank.Size and format: One landscape 16:9 comparison image; free-tier resolution is fine.
bank.Typography and layout details: Equal-sized side-by-side panels with readable labels; other styling is your call.
